metadata.dataset_name: Verdant AI Botanical Plant Care & Health Remedies Dataset
metadata.license: Open Botanical Knowledge License (Creative Commons BY-NC 4.0)
metadata.description: Comprehensive botanical dataset containing species-specific care protocols, organic remedies, symptom treatment matrices, multi-angle inspection guides, and validation rules for domestic and garden flora.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Water strictly when top 1.5 inches of soil feels dry. Tulsi roots suffocate rapidly in waterlogged clay; ensure fast drainage and morning watering.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Requires 4 to 6 hours of warm morning sun (7 AM to 11 AM). Shelter from cold winter drafts, frost, and excessive direct noon summer sun.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Leaves are consumed in tea and home remedies — NEVER use synthetic pesticides! For aphids, whiteflies, or black bugs, use organic cold-pressed Neem Oil emulsion (5ml/L lukewarm water + 2 drops mild soap) applied at sunset.
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: Requires airy, well-draining soil (50% garden loam, 30% coarse sand/perlite, 20% vermicompost). Top-dress monthly with 2 tablespoons of aged cow dung manure or compost tea.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Sacred Basil Manjari (Seed Spike) De-heading: Regularly pinch off purple flowering seed clusters. If seeds mature, the plant halts vegetative growth, turns yellow, and rapidly dies of natural senescence.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Sacred Basil Manjari (Seed Spike) De-heading
step_by_step_remedies.action: Regularly pinch off purple flowering seed clusters (Manjari). If seeds mature, the plant stops vegetative growth, turns yellow, and rapidly dies of natural senescence.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Culinary-Safe Neem Foliar Treatment
step_by_step_remedies.action: Mix 5ml pure organic neem oil + 2ml liquid soap into 1 litre warm water. Spray undersides of leaves every 7 days at dusk to eliminate aphids and spider mites without chemical residue.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Root-Zone Aeration & Water Withholding
step_by_step_remedies.action: If leaves are turning yellow, roots are lacking oxygen. Stop watering for 3 days, aerate top 2 inches of soil with a small wooden stick, and ensure bottom drainage holes are unblocked.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Morning Sunlight Alignment
step_by_step_remedies.action: Place the pot where it receives gentle morning rays from 7 AM to 11 AM. Avoid harsh afternoon scorching sun during peak summer and keep off freezing tile floors in winter.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Withhold water immediately for 72 hours; aerate topsoil; check for clay compaction; add 1 tablespoon vermicompost.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Shield from cold nighttime drafts; ensure morning watering before hot sun; increase ambient humidity.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Wash tender shoots with lukewarm water jet; apply cold-pressed neem oil (5ml/L) weekly at dusk.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: If soil is bone dry, soak container in water basin for 30 minutes; if soil is already damp, unpot to inspect for black rotted roots.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Move to brighter morning sunlight location; apply diluted fermented cow dung manure or mustard cake liquid fertilizer.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Deep watering when top 1 inch is dry. Hibiscus drinks heavily during active blooming season, but hates sitting in stagnant saucer runoff.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Demands 6 to 8 hours of intense direct sunlight daily. Insufficient sun directly causes premature flower bud drop and leggy weak foliage.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Prime target for cottony white mealybugs and aphids on flower buds. Blast bugs away with a sharp water jet, dab stubborn clusters with 70% alcohol on cotton swabs, then spray neem oil weekly.
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: High Potassium Protocol: Hibiscus demands high potassium (K) and low phosphorus (P). High phosphorus locks out iron and stunts flower production. Use banana peel tea or high-K fertilizer (NPK 17-5-24).

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: High-Potassium Banana Peel Nutrition & Hard Pruning: Soak chopped banana peels in water for 48 hours and feed monthly; prune old woody branches by one-third in early spring to force vigorous new flowering wood.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Mealybug & Bud-Drop Eradication
step_by_step_remedies.action: Inspect leaf axils and flower calyxes for white cottony clusters. Dab directly with a cotton swab dipped in rubbing alcohol, then spray neem-soap solution weekly.

step_by_step_remedies.title: High-Potassium Banana Peel Nutrition
step_by_step_remedies.action: Soak chopped banana peels in water for 48 hours and pour around root zone twice a month to fuel massive flower bud formation and prevent yellow leaf chlorosis.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Hard Pruning on New Wood
step_by_step_remedies.action: Hibiscus flowers only bloom on new green branches. Prune back tall leggy stems by one-third in early spring to stimulate vigorous blooming shoots.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Regulate Watering Schedule
step_by_step_remedies.action: Sudden dry-to-flood watering shocks Hibiscus, causing leaves to turn bright yellow and drop within 48 hours. Keep soil consistently lightly moist.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Classic sign of overwatering shock or iron chlorosis. Apply chelated iron foliar spray and potassium-rich banana peel fertilizer.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Heat stress or fertilizer salt buildup; flush pot with clean water and avoid high chemical nitrogen salts.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Aphids and spider mites on bud undersides; spray with insecticidal soap and prune heavily infested flower stems.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: High heat transpiration; water thoroughly until water drains from the base and protect container from scorching hot concrete.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Nutrient deficiency; apply balanced organic compost tea with added wood ash or sulfate of potash.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Water the root perimeter deeply in the morning. NEVER splash water onto rose foliage in the evening, as damp leaves trigger Black Spot fungal blight.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Needs 6+ hours of unobstructed direct sun and high airflow to deter powdery mildew.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Aphids, thrips, and Black Spot fungus (Diplocarpon rosae). Spray organic baking soda fungicide (1 tsp baking soda + 1/2 tsp horticultural oil in 1L water) every 10 days.
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: Heavy feeder: Feed with balanced rose fertilizer enriched with Epsom salts (1 tbsp magnesium sulfate per gallon) for vibrant petal pigmentation.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Black Spot Sanitation & 5-Leaflet Node Deadheading: Remove all infected spotted leaves; prune spent blooms 1/4 inch above the first outward-facing 5-leaflet leaf node at a 45-degree angle.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Black Spot Surgical Sanitation
step_by_step_remedies.action: Immediately pluck and discard any leaves showing black circular spots with yellow fringes. Do not compost infected leaves.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Deadheading Above 5-Leaflet Node
step_by_step_remedies.action: Cut spent, fading flowers 1/4 inch above the first outward-facing 5-leaflet leaf node at a 45-degree angle to trigger fast re-blooming.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Organic Baking Soda Fungicide
step_by_step_remedies.action: Dissolve 1 tsp baking soda + 1 tsp mild horticultural oil in 1 liter water; spray weekly to suppress mildew spores.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Black Spot disease or poor drainage; prune lower infected foliage and apply baking soda fungicide.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Sun scorch on delicate petals or potassium deficiency; increase deep ground watering.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Sawfly larvae or black spot fungal lesions; handpick caterpillars and spray with copper fungicide.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Root nematode attack or severe root dry-out; drench soil and mulch with organic shredded bark.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Lack of direct sun or magnesium deficit; apply 1 tablespoon Epsom salts dissolved in water.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Extreme drought-hardy succulent. Water only every 2 to 3 weeks in summer, and once every 4 to 5 weeks in winter. The soil must be 100% bone-dry before watering.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Tolerates low light to bright indirect sun. Protect from scorching magnification behind south-facing window glass.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Virtually pest-free. Yellow, soft, or mushy leaves are a 100% symptom of overwatering and root rot.
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: Minimal feeding required. Use cactus/succulent gritty mix with 50% pumice and coarse perlite.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Emergency Cinnamon Root Rot Rescue: Unpot immediately if base is mushy; slice off black soggy roots; dust cut surfaces with cinnamon powder; repot into bone-dry perlite soil.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Emergency Root Rot Rescue
step_by_step_remedies.action: If leaf base is soggy or mushy, remove plant from pot immediately. Cut away brown rotten roots, dust healthy cut ends with cinnamon powder, and repot in dry succulent soil.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Enforce Strict Drought Interval
step_by_step_remedies.action: Stop all watering for 3 full weeks. Snake plants store gallons of water in their rigid fleshy leaves and thrive on neglect.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Severe overwatering; unpot, remove rotted rhizomes, and withhold water for 1 month.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Physical damage or cold damage below 10°C; move away from drafty windows.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Rare fungal red leaf spot from overhead splashing; keep foliage completely dry.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Wrinkled, folded leaves mean long-term dehydration; soak pot in water basin for 15 minutes.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Normal slow growth in low light; move to bright indirect sunlight to boost growth.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Water when top 2 inches dry out. Limp drooping vines mean dry soil; yellow translucent leaves mean soggy soil.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Flourishes in bright indirect sunlight. If golden marble variegation disappears and leaves turn solid green, move closer to a window.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Occasionally scale insects or mealybugs on vine nodes. Wipe leaves with diluted neem oil.
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: Diluted balanced liquid feed (20-20-20 at quarter strength) once a month during growing season.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Microfiber Dusting & Node Pruning: Clean broad leaves monthly to unblock stomata; snip bare leggy vines below aerial root nodes to propagate bushy new growth in water.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Foliar Microfiber Dusting
step_by_step_remedies.action: Wipe broad leaves monthly with a damp cloth to remove household dust, allowing leaves to absorb maximum indirect light.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Pruning & Water Propagation
step_by_step_remedies.action: Snip bare, leggy vine sections just below a brown aerial root node; place in clean water to root new bushy plants.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Waterlogged soil or root-bound pot; repot into fresh porous potting mix and empty saucer tray.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Dry indoor air or chlorine in tap water; mist foliage and use dechlorinated standing water.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Mealybugs on stem junctions; wipe nodes with 70% alcohol dipped cotton bud.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Soil has completely dried out; submerge pot in lukewarm water until bubbles stop rising.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Insufficient indirect light; move within 3 feet of an east-facing window.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Deep, steady watering at the base. Uneven watering causes fruit splitting and Blossom End Rot.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Requires 8+ hours of intense full sun outdoors.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Hornworms, aphids, and early blight fungus. Remove all foliage within 10 inches of the ground to prevent soil-splashed spores.
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: Requires high calcium (bone meal / crushed eggshells) and potassium for fruit development.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Blossom-End Rot Calcium Protocol & Lower Canopy Sanitation: Mulch soil heavily to maintain steady hydration; prune all leaves within 10 inches of soil to stop blight spores.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Blossom-End Rot Calcium Protocol
step_by_step_remedies.action: Add dolomitic lime or gypsum and mulch soil with 2 inches of straw to maintain consistent moisture and prevent black fruit bottoms.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Lower Canopy Sanitation
step_by_step_remedies.action: Prune all bottom leaves touching the soil line to block fungal spores from splashing onto foliage during rain.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Early blight or nitrogen deficiency in lower leaves; trim infected foliage and apply organic tomato feed.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Potassium deficiency or heat scorch; mulch heavily with organic straw.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Flea beetles or hornworms; handpick large green caterpillars and dust with diatomaceous earth.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Bacterial wilt or severe thirst; check stem vascular tissue for discoloration.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Phosphorus deficiency (purple leaf undersides); apply bone meal or rock phosphate.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Soak-and-dry method. Water deeply until liquid exits the bottom, then wait 3 to 4 weeks until bone dry. Never pour water into the center crown.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Bright indirect light or gentle morning sun. Intense midday scorching sun turns leaves reddish-brown.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Rarely gets pests. Soft mushy leaves indicate waterlogged roots.
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: Cactus soil mix in a porous terracotta pot.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Sunburn Color Restoration & Terracotta Drainage: Shift plant 3 feet back from hot scorching windows to restore rich emerald gel plumpness; use unglazed terracotta.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Sunburn & Red Leaf Relief
step_by_step_remedies.action: If leaves turn brown or bronze, the plant is getting excessive UV scorch. Shift 3 feet back from the hot window to restore emerald gel plumpness.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Terracotta Moisture Regulation
step_by_step_remedies.action: Repot into an unglazed terracotta pot with drainage holes to allow rapid root moisture evaporation.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Waterlogged potting soil; stop watering, remove yellow limp outer leaves, repot into gritty sand.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Sun scorch from sudden transition to intense direct sunlight; acclimate gradually.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Aloe rust fungus; keep leaves completely dry and apply sulfur dust.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Translucent flat leaves indicate water starvation; give one thorough bottom soak.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Inadequate light causing thin, spidery leaves; move closer to a bright window.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Loves consistently moist soil. Bottom water whenever the top 0.5 inch begins to feel dry.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Bright morning light and partial afternoon shade. High afternoon heat wilts mint leaves rapidly.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Aphids and spider mites. Spray with cool water jet and mild insecticidal soap.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Shoot Pinching & Root Container Isolation: Pinch top 2 inches weekly to force bushy growth and halt bitter flowering; isolate in separate container to block invasive root runners.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Frequent Pinching for Bushy Habit
step_by_step_remedies.action: Pinch off top 2-3 inches of stems weekly. This prevents flowering and forces rapid branching into dense, aromatic foliage.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Container Root Isolation
step_by_step_remedies.action: Always grow mint in its own dedicated pot to prevent its aggressive runners from choking surrounding plants.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Roots have become pot-bound; divide root ball in half and repot into fresh rich soil.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Severe underwatering or scorching dry heat; trim crispy stems to base for fresh regrowth.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Mint rust fungus; prune infected stems to soil level and disinfect scissors.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Thirst reaction in hot sun; bottom water immediately, plant will recover in 2 hours.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Lack of light or nutrient exhaustion; move to morning sun and add vermicompost.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Water when top 1 inch is dry or when leaves just begin to relax. Highly sensitive to fluoride and chlorine in tap water.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Medium indirect light. Direct sunlight burns foliage with permanent scorch marks.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Spider mites and fungus gnats in moist potting mix.
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: Half-strength houseplant fertilizer in spring and summer.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Fluoride Water Filtering & Pebble Humidity Tray: Use filtered/rainwater to stop brown leaf tips; place pot on pebble water tray to boost ambient humidity.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Filtered Water Switch for Brown Tips
step_by_step_remedies.action: Brown leaf tips are caused by tap chlorine and fluoride. Water with filtered, distilled, or rainwater left standing for 24 hours.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Pebble Humidity Tray
step_by_step_remedies.action: Place pot on a saucer filled with pebbles and water to increase ambient humidity without making roots soggy.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Old leaf senescence or overwatering; trim lower yellow leaves and let topsoil dry.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Chemical burn from municipal tap water; switch to distilled or rainwater.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Fungus gnats from soggy soil surface; allow top 2 inches of soil to dry out.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Dramatic wilt signal when dry; water thoroughly and plant stands erect within 4 hours.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Low light blocking blooms; move closer to filtered window light.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Water ground when top inch dries; keep flowers dry to prevent petal rot.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Full direct sunlight (6+ hours) for prolific non-stop blooms.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Natural insect repelling qualities, but prone to spider mites in hot dry weather.
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: Moderate feeding; avoid high nitrogen which produces all leaves and zero flowers.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Weekly Flower Deadheading & Spider Mite Water Rinse: Snip faded blooms weekly to trigger rapid new flower bud sets; wash leaf undersides with cold water jet.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Weekly Flower Deadheading
step_by_step_remedies.action: Pluck faded, brown blossoms immediately to redirect plant energy into producing a continuous wave of fresh buds.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Spider Mite Water Rinse
step_by_step_remedies.action: Spray undersides of leaves with a firm jet of cold water in the morning to disperse fine webs and spider mites.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Wet foliage causing fungal collar rot; water strictly at soil line in the morning.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Spider mite webbing damage; spray sulfur wash or neem emulsion.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Snails or slugs eating flowers; sprinkle crushed eggshells around pot perimeter.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Root dry-out in small terracotta container; move to larger container with mulch.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Too much shade; relocate to maximum direct sunlight exposure.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Consistent moisture; allow top 1 inch to dry between waterings.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Needs 6 to 8 hours of hot direct sun.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Thrips and mites causing upward leaf curling.
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: High phosphorus and potassium once flowering begins; calcium to stop blossom end rot.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Leaf Curl Neem Treatment & Flower Pollination Shake: Spray neem under curled leaves to kill thrips; gently shake flowering stems daily to ensure heavy fruit setting.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Leaf Curl Spray Treatment
step_by_step_remedies.action: Upward curled leaves indicate thrips or calcium deficiency. Spray neem oil on leaf undersides and sprinkle wood ash around base.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Flower Drop Prevention
step_by_step_remedies.action: Shake flower clusters gently by hand to encourage self-pollination and maintain steady watering.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Overwatering or cold night shock; keep warm and let potting soil dry between waterings.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Potassium deficiency; apply banana peel water or wood ash.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Thrips or aphids causing distorted leaf edges; spray cold-pressed neem soap.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Severe midday heat; water thoroughly in early morning.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Calcium deficiency (crinkled new leaves); add bone meal or gypsum to soil.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Water when top 2-3 inches of potting medium are dry. Empty excess saucer runoff.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Bright filtered light. Direct sun scorches leaves, while low light halts leaf fenestrations (splits).
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: Balanced 20-20-20 fertilizer monthly during active growth.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Coco-Coir Moss Pole Training & Monthly Foliar Cleanse: Guide aerial roots onto a damp moss pole to trigger massive split leaves; wipe dust with damp microfiber cloth.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Moss Pole Staking for Aerial Roots
step_by_step_remedies.action: Train creeping stems onto a damp coco-coir or moss pole. Aerial root support stimulates massive, fenestrated leaves.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Monthly Leaf Cleanse
step_by_step_remedies.action: Wipe broad leaves with a damp microfiber cloth to remove dust and optimize photosynthetic gas exchange.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Waterlogged root zone; check saucer drainage and delay next watering by 5 days.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Low humidity or intense scorching sunlight; move out of direct beams.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Thrips larvae feeding on leaf surface; wash foliage and apply insecticidal soap.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Underwatering or root-bound pot; repot into container 2 inches wider.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Lack of fenestrations (splits); move closer to bright filtered window light.

species_dataset.native_climate: Southern Europe, North Africa, and Southwest Asia

care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Morning sun and cool afternoon shade.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Aphids on tender stems; wash with mild soap.
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: Light organic vermicompost; avoid excess nitrogen.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Bolting Heat Defense & Continuous Outer Harvesting: Keep roots cool with light mulch to stop premature bitter flowering; harvest outer leaves weekly.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Bolting Prevention
step_by_step_remedies.action: In hot weather (>25°C), move to shade to stop coriander from bolting into bitter flowers.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Regular Outer Leaf Harvesting
step_by_step_remedies.action: Cut outer stems continually to stimulate new leafy shoots from the crown.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Waterlogged roots; ensure rapid container drainage.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: High afternoon temperature scorch; provide afternoon shade.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Aphids clustering under flower heads; wash with mild organic soap.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Shallow root dry-out; maintain consistent light moisture.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Exhausted potting mix; top-dress with vermicompost.

care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Check for swallowtail caterpillars and aphids.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Deep Taproot Hydration & Crown Aeration: Water around root perimeter; keep mulch away from central growing crown.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Moisture Balance
step_by_step_remedies.action: Do not allow root zone to dry completely; maintain light mulching.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Base Watering
step_by_step_remedies.action: Water around root crown to maintain healthy, crisp fronds.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Root rot from soggy soil or old outer fronds; harvest outer foliage.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Sun scorch in dry climate; increase soil moisture.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Septoria leaf spot fungus; remove spotted leaves.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Dry root ball; water deeply until bottom drains.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Needs nitrogen boost; apply organic fish or seaweed emulsion.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Water when top 1.5 inches dry. Never let roots sit in icy stagnant water.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Demands 5 to 6 hours of warm sunlight. Protect from winter frost.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Scale insects and psyllids; spray sour buttermilk (1:5 dilution with water) or neem oil.
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: Needs acidic to neutral soil. Feed with 1 cup sour buttermilk or curd water monthly for iron boost.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Sour Buttermilk & Epsom Salt Iron Boost: Drench root zone with fermented buttermilk (100ml in 1L water) and 1 tsp Epsom salts monthly to stop pale yellow leaf chlorosis.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Sour Buttermilk Soil Drench
step_by_step_remedies.action: Pour 1 glass of sour fermented curd water into the pot once a month. The natural lactic acid bacteria acidify the soil and unlock iron nutrients.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Spring Canopy Pruning
step_by_step_remedies.action: Prune tall woody tops in late winter. This triggers multiple bushy branching shoots packed with aromatic leaves.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Iron chlorosis; apply sour buttermilk drench and move to sunny location.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Winter cold draft damage; bring container indoors near a sunny window.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Scale insects or black sooty mold; wipe stems with neem oil wash.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Waterlogged clay soil; repot with 40% sand and perlite.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Low soil acidity or nitrogen deficit; feed with composted cow manure.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Deep watering during hot blooming season; allow surface soil to dry slightly between sessions.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Full sun (6+ hours) for intense fragrance and abundant buds.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Bud worms and whiteflies; spray organic neem oil weekly.
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: Enriched compost and bone meal for phosphorus bloom stimulation.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Post-Bloom Cane Pruning & Bone Meal Feeding: Prune stems back after each flowering flush and add 1 tablespoon bone meal to trigger immediate fresh flower bud clusters.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Post-Bloom Shoot Pruning
step_by_step_remedies.action: After flowers fade, trim the branch back by 4 inches. Jasmine blooms only on fresh shoots, so trimming forces immediate re-blooming.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Organic Phosphorus Bone Meal
step_by_step_remedies.action: Work 1 tablespoon of organic bone meal or rock phosphate into topsoil to stimulate high bud count and potent fragrance.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Overwatering or iron deficiency; ensure rapid drainage and full sunlight.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Severe heat dehydration; mulch with coco-coir.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Bud worms boring into flower buds; spray neem oil before buds open.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Thirsty plant in direct summer heat; water deeply in the early morning.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Shady spot; move to direct sunlight veranda.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Stores gallons in underground potato-like rhizomes. Water only once every 3 to 4 weeks. Soil must be bone dry.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Tolerates deepest shade to bright indirect light.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Virtually immune to pests; only susceptible to root rot from overwatering.
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: Gritty succulent cactus mix with pumice.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Rhizome Drought Protocol: Withhold water completely for 4 weeks if lower stems turn yellow or wrinkled; unpot and discard soft brown rhizomes.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Rhizome Inspection & Rot Rescue
step_by_step_remedies.action: If stems become soft or fall over, unpot immediately. Healthy rhizomes look like firm potatoes. Cut away mushy parts and repot in dry gritty mix.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Monthly Neglect Schedule
step_by_step_remedies.action: Water only once every month. ZZ plants flourish on neglect and suffer exclusively from well-intentioned over-attention.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Rotting rhizomes from excess moisture; stop all watering for 1 month.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Extreme scorch from direct sun behind glass; move into indirect room light.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Rare scale; wipe glossy leaves with damp cloth.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Severe stem rot or extreme dehydration; check rhizome firmness.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Normal growth rate (1-2 new shoots per season); move to bright indirect spot.

care_snapshot.hydration_protocol: Water thoroughly when fleshy leaves begin to feel slightly soft or wrinkly; usually every 2 weeks.
care_snapshot.light_exposure_protocol: Needs 4 to 6 hours of bright direct or filtered sunlight.
care_snapshot.pest_pathogen_defense: Mealybugs hiding in stem joints; swab with rubbing alcohol.
care_snapshot.soil_nutrition_protocol: Porous succulent soil in a heavy ceramic or terracotta pot to prevent tipping.

species_dataset.signature_critical_remedy: Leaf Firmness Turgor Test: Squeeze lower leaves gently: if firm like pebbles, do NOT water; if slightly soft or wrinkled, give a thorough soak.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Leaf Turgor Squeeze Test
step_by_step_remedies.action: Never water on a calendar schedule. Squeeze a mature leaf gently: water only when it yields slightly to finger pressure.

step_by_step_remedies.title: Stem Pruning for Tree Trunk Vigor
step_by_step_remedies.action: Prune back drooping branch ends to encourage the main trunk to thicken into a sturdy, bonsai-like woody stem.

symptom_treatment_matrix.yellowing_leaves: Soggy soil causing root rot; withhold water until soil is completely dry.
symptom_treatment_matrix.brown_crispy_edges: Sun scorch on unacclimated leaves; introduce direct sunlight gradually.
symptom_treatment_matrix.spots_holes_webbing: Cottony mealybugs on stem forks; dab with 70% alcohol on cotton swab.
symptom_treatment_matrix.drooping_wilting: Wrinkled, shriveled leaves mean prolonged drought; soak pot in water.
symptom_treatment_matrix.pale_stunted_growth: Stretching toward light (etiolation); move to brightest available windowsill.

rejected_non_plant_categories: household furniture (chairs, desks, sofas, cups, bottles, clocks)
